notes.title: Bug Fixes + Few new Features + "FATAL ERROR" update
notes.content:
[p]Hi![/p][p]We've just updated the demo with few quality of life features and some bug fixes.
[/p][list][*][p]We've added an option to invert X and Y axis for mouse and controller[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Head bob / Camera Shake can now be turned on or off[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We've added a FOV slider [/p][/*][*][p]You can zoom in and out with RMB / B button on controller[/p][/*][*][p]Several bug Fixes in regards to physics[/p][/*][*][p]There shouldn't be a hiccup while approaching the large door in second area anymore.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We were made aware that a rare bug occurs, when players try to get into the game from Lobby, and it would result in "Fatal Error", We did some digging, and improved the code where we though it might fix the issue. We had a hard time replicating it on our side, therefore it's difficult for us to say for sure that it's 100% fixed, but we did what we could based on logs provided by some players!

Also some players reported that verifying the files fixed it for them. That being said, if that issue occurs to You, please join our Discord, we would love to get a crash-log from You, so we can investigate the issue further.[/p][p][/p][p]Happy puzzle solving![/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest, Kickstarter & Demo Update! + New Trailer coming soon!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We're happy to share few news with you all, so let's get to it!

[b]Kickstarter[/b]

We are launching a [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/scrumptious-sprouts/inkwellerss-a-cooperative-puzzle-game-for-two]Kickstarter[/url] campaign soon, and the pre-launch page is up, so please go and follow it! We decided to go with crowd funding for few things - Soundtrack and SFX, Localization and extra Marketing, so all the things we are most lacking in, or are unable to do ourselves. Of course if the campaign is not a success, we will do our best to deliver the game in the best state we will be able to.

[b]Steam Next Fest[/b]

We are participating in the upcoming Steam Next Fest event, which is going to start next Monday 9th of June! We'd love to hear from you, so leave us a review, tell us what you think about the game! 

[b]Demo Update[/b]

We've just updated the demo with few quality of life improvements, here some of those:

- Host can swap which player plays as which character freely
- Character animation now follows where the player is looking, so no more blank staring straight ahead at all times :)
- Fixed jumping animation for male character
- Voice Chat Volume value indicator shows the correct value

[b]New Trailer coming soon![/b]

We are currently working on a new trailer, that will showcase even more of Inkwellers, so stay tuned for that!

Thank you so much for joining us on this journey!


Here's few screenshots of new areas you will be able to explore in the full game:

notes.title: Inkwellers Demo Controller Support & dev Update
notes.content:
Hi!

We're happy to announce that the latest update for Inkwellers Demo now includes controller support! 
So whether you prefer keyboard and mouse or gamepad, you can play the way you like!

This update also brings a handful of improvements and bug fixes to improve the experience.

As for the development, we are happy to share that we are still on track for Q4 2025 release. All the major system we planned for the full game are now implemented! While there is still a lot of work ahead of us, it's mostly focused on creating assets, wrapping up puzzle designs, and programming said puzzles :)

Thanks to everyone who gave the demo a go, all 3,093 of you! and congrats to 2084 of you who have seen it through to the end! Also thank you for all the positive reviews, it really helps, and means a lot to us.  

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/ZJAbX8Gsj3]discord[/url]!

Thanks!

notes.title: Inkwellers Demo is Coming Jan 16th!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Over the past three weeks, we've been hard at work playtesting and polishing the demo of Inkwellers, and we’re happy to announce that we’re nearly ready to share it with you! 🎉

Here’s what you can expect in the demo:

✨ Two Unique Areas:

    [b]Area 1 - Arrival Garden[/b] : A communication-focused challenge with three puzzles that heavily rely on you and your partner communicating what you see, to piece together the solution.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45070418/d34909490018248fdaebc12afe5093948e62ec30.jpg[/img]

    [b]Area 2 - Father's Study[/b] : A more Escape Room-style experience featuring four puzzles, all designed to keep you working together to solve them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45070418/cc4ff6055fe240e3e1201cd4969a934bc632ffbe.jpg[/img]

We’ve poured a lot of love and work into this, and we can’t wait for you to explore the world of Inkwellers and tackle the puzzles with a friend. Your feedback will mean the world to us as we continue the development of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45070418/5c962c20500390e204952a3b2ada270f9b5b1369.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates, and let us know what you think once you’ve had a chance to play. 💬

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

We thought to give everyone who's interested a small update on what we've been working on, and overall where we're at with the project.

[b]DEMO[/b]

First and foremost we are focusing 90% of our energy on making the demo, 

To give you an idea what will you be able to see in the demo - It will include 8 puzzles, two of which will be a bit more complex and layered, with other six more linear, but keep in mind that includes tutorial puzzles. All this will be happening in four major areas, out of those areas :

One is complete
Two are almost done and we are aiming to complete those within next two weeks.
One is half-way done, and still needs quite a bit of work in terms of 3d and implementing puzzles.

[b]PLAYER CHARACTER[/b]

In other news, just yesterday we finished working on one of our Player Character model, textures and rig! so all that's left is to animate, which thankfully one of our team members is really good at it B)

[b]TUTORIAL[/b]

We also finished working on the visuals and puzzles for tutorial area, so that's all playable and next in line for internal testing!

That's about it, thanks for reading!

ScrumptySproutEnojyer out
